theme.en: AI Demand Tests the Supply Stack

dek.en: AI demand is pulling on every layer at once: domestic accelerator clusters, DRAM pricing, power fabs, probe infrastructure, and raw-material controls. The day's stories show capacity becoming strategic leverage, but no single policy or supplier can remove the bottleneck alone.
dek.zh: AI需求正在同时拉紧每一层供应：国产加速器集群、DRAM价格、功率半导体晶圆厂、探针基础设施以及原材料管制。今天的新闻显示产能正在变成战略筹码，但没有单一政策或供应商能够独自解除瓶颈。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Meituan trains a 1.6T-parameter model on 50,000 domestic chips
title.zh: 美团使用50,000颗国产芯片训练1.6万亿参数模型

summary.en: Meituan reportedly trained a 1.6 trillion-parameter AI model on 50,000 domestic chips, framing the run as a workaround to U.S. export controls. The report matters because it points to Chinese internet firms building large clusters around local silicon instead of waiting for unrestricted access to Nvidia-class parts. It does not prove performance parity, but it shows that scale-out architecture is becoming part of the export-control contest.
summary.zh: 报道称，美团使用50,000颗国产芯片训练了一个1.6万亿参数AI模型，并将其视为绕开美国出口管制的路径。其意义在于，中国互联网公司正在围绕本土硅片搭建大型集群，而不是等待不受限制地获得Nvidia级别器件。这并不证明性能已经对等，但说明横向扩展架构正成为出口管制博弈的一部分。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: Germany opens a $5.7B power semiconductor fab
title.zh: 德国启用一座57亿美元功率半导体晶圆厂

summary.en: Germany opened a power semiconductor fab backed by a $5.7 billion investment, with the source describing it as the world's largest facility of its kind. The project adds European capacity in a segment tied to EVs, industrial drives, energy systems, and grid hardware rather than leading-edge logic. It also shows that regional semiconductor policy is spreading beyond advanced-node foundry capacity into power devices and industrial resilience.
summary.zh: 德国启用了一座投资57亿美元的功率半导体晶圆厂，原报道称其为同类设施中全球最大。这一项目增加的是与电动车、工业驱动、能源系统和电网硬件相关的欧洲产能，而非最先进逻辑制程。它也说明区域半导体政策正在从先进制程代工扩展到功率器件和工业韧性。

title.en: India advances a $13.2B semiconductor push with a chip research hub
title.zh: 印度以芯片研究中心推进132亿美元半导体计划

summary.en: India advanced a $13.2 billion semiconductor program with a new chip research hub. The move adds an R&D layer to a national effort that has mostly been measured through fab, assembly, and subsidy announcements. For suppliers, the signal is that India wants a broader domestic stack, not only imported tools placed inside subsidized shells.
summary.zh: 印度通过新的芯片研究中心推进一项132亿美元半导体计划。这为一个过去更多由晶圆厂、封装和补贴公告衡量的国家项目增加了研发层。对供应商而言，这释放的信号是印度希望建设更完整的本土栈，而不只是把进口设备放进补贴厂房。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: UBS doubles its DRAM price forecast as shortages stretch toward 2028
title.zh: UBS上调DRAM涨价预期，短缺或延续至2028年

summary.en: UBS doubled its DRAM price forecast and said demand could outpace supply by 17 percentage points through 2027, with market tightness potentially lasting until the second quarter of 2028. The forecast aligns with TrendForce's view that third-quarter shortages remain severe, even if consumer-price sensitivity slows the rate of increase. For AI servers, the implication is that memory remains a gating input rather than a passive commodity line item.
summary.zh: UBS将DRAM价格预测上调一倍，并称到2027年需求可能比供应高出17个百分点，市场紧张可能持续到2028年第二季度。这与TrendForce关于三季度DRAM仍严重短缺的判断相符，尽管消费端价格敏感度可能放缓涨幅。对AI服务器而言，存储仍是限制投入，而不是被动的商品化成本项。

title.en: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron face a new DRAM price-fixing lawsuit
title.zh: Samsung、SK hynix与Micron面临新的DRAM价格操纵诉讼

summary.en: Samsung, SK hynix, and Micron are facing another U.S. antitrust class action over alleged DRAM price-fixing, with 17 plaintiffs suing in the Northern District of California in late June. The twist is HBM allocation: unlike older DRAM cases, AI-driven capacity choices may become part of the argument about supply discipline and pricing power. The case does not establish wrongdoing, but it raises legal risk just as memory margins are expanding.
summary.zh: Samsung、SK hynix和Micron在美国面临新的反垄断集体诉讼，17名原告已于6月下旬在加州北区联邦法院起诉，指控DRAM价格操纵。新的变量是HBM分配：与早期DRAM案件不同，AI驱动的产能选择可能进入关于供给纪律和定价能力的论证。该案件本身并不证明违规，但在存储利润率扩张之际增加了法律风险。

title.en: CXMT reportedly lands a $3B Tencent memory deal
title.zh: 报道称CXMT获得腾讯30亿美元存储订单

summary.en: CXMT reportedly landed a $3 billion memory deal with Tencent as Chinese AI infrastructure buyers look deeper into the domestic supply chain. If confirmed, the order would give CXMT a large anchor customer outside commodity PC and mobile DRAM cycles. It also links memory localization directly to AI training and inference capacity, not just to import substitution policy.
summary.zh: 报道称，CXMT获得了腾讯30亿美元存储订单，显示中国AI基础设施买家正在更深入地转向本土供应链。如果属实，该订单将为CXMT带来一个超越PC和手机DRAM周期的大型锚定客户。它还把存储国产化直接连接到AI训练和推理产能，而不仅是进口替代政策。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: FormFactor wins a $24.2M grant for a U.S. semiconductor facility
title.zh: FormFactor获得2420万美元美国半导体设施补助

summary.en: FormFactor won a $24.2 million grant tied to a U.S. semiconductor facility. The dollar amount is small next to fab subsidies, but wafer probe and test capacity are critical once advanced packaging and high-value AI parts enter production. The award is another reminder that resilient semiconductor supply chains depend on metrology, probe, and test infrastructure as much as on headline wafer capacity.
summary.zh: FormFactor获得了一笔与美国半导体设施相关的2420万美元补助。与晶圆厂补贴相比金额不大，但当先进封装和高价值AI器件进入量产时，晶圆探针和测试能力十分关键。这项补助再次说明，半导体供应链韧性不仅取决于晶圆产能，也取决于量测、探针和测试基础设施。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Chipmakers push back on broad White House memory-market intervention
title.zh: 芯片厂商反对白宫广泛干预存储市场

summary.en: Chipmakers are urging the White House to avoid broad intervention in the memory market. The pushback comes as AI demand tightens DRAM and HBM supply, making memory a policy target as well as a pricing story. It suggests suppliers want Washington to focus on capacity and resilience without turning memory allocation into an administered market.
summary.zh: 芯片厂商正敦促白宫避免对存储市场进行广泛干预。此举发生在AI需求拉紧DRAM和HBM供给之际，使存储同时成为政策目标和价格议题。这表明供应商希望华盛顿聚焦产能和韧性，而不是把存储分配变成行政化市场。

title.en: Rare-earth export controls rise on Europe's chip-risk list
title.zh: 稀土出口管制升上欧洲芯片风险清单

summary.en: Europe's chip industry is warning that rare-earth export controls now rank among its major strategic risks. The concern widens the semiconductor policy map from lithography tools and advanced chips to upstream materials with fewer substitutes. For European manufacturers, the issue is not only access to fabs, but whether the materials base can absorb geopolitical shocks.
summary.zh: 欧洲芯片行业警告称，稀土出口管制已成为其主要战略风险之一。这把半导体政策版图从光刻设备和先进芯片扩展到替代来源更少的上游材料。对欧洲制造商而言，问题不只是能否获得晶圆厂产能，还包括材料基础能否承受地缘政治冲击。

title.en: Washington's AI export-control model draws fresh criticism
title.zh: 华盛顿AI出口管制模式再遭批评

summary.en: A new policy analysis argues that Washington's AI export-control approach has not held as intended. The critique lands alongside reports of domestic Chinese training clusters and local memory procurement, both of which point to adaptation rather than a simple supply cutoff. The policy question is shifting from whether controls can block hardware flows to whether they can slow system-level capability growth.
summary.zh: 一篇新的政策分析认为，华盛顿的AI出口管制路径并未按预期维持效果。这一批评与中国本土训练集群和本地存储采购的报道同时出现，二者都指向适应性调整，而不是简单的供应切断。政策问题正在从管制能否阻断硬件流动，转向能否减缓系统级能力增长。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 财报与市场

title.en: Intel raises prices on selected Core Ultra and Xeon processors
title.zh: Intel上调部分Core Ultra与Xeon处理器价格

summary.en: Intel confirmed price increases on selected consumer and server CPUs, citing market dynamics, rising costs, and strong demand. Some Xeon processors are now more than $1,000 more expensive, according to the report. The move gives Intel room to defend margins, but it also raises platform costs for customers still balancing CPU supply, accelerator purchases, and data-center budgets.
summary.zh: Intel确认上调部分消费级和服务器CPU价格，理由包括市场动态、成本上升和需求强劲。报道称，部分Xeon处理器涨价幅度超过1,000美元。这一举措有助于Intel维护利润率，但也会提高客户的平台成本，尤其是在CPU供给、加速器采购和数据中心预算之间权衡的客户。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Ayar Labs raises $500M at a $3.75B valuation
title.zh: Ayar Labs以37.5亿美元估值融资5亿美元

summary.en: Ayar Labs raised $500 million at a $3.75 billion valuation as investors keep funding AI-infrastructure plays beyond merchant GPUs. The company's optical I/O focus sits close to a real bottleneck: moving data between accelerators, memory, and switches without letting power and latency dominate the system. The funding round does not settle adoption risk, but it is large enough to keep photonic interconnects in the strategic conversation.
summary.zh: Ayar Labs以37.5亿美元估值融资5亿美元，显示投资者仍在押注通用GPU之外的AI基础设施公司。该公司的光I/O方向贴近一个真实瓶颈：在加速器、存储和交换芯片之间移动数据，同时避免功耗和延迟主导系统成本。这轮融资不能消除采用风险，但规模足以让光互连继续留在战略讨论中。

theme.en: Memory-Centric Compute Moves Closer to Silicon
theme.zh: 以存储为中心的计算走近硅片

dek.en: This week's research queue emphasizes measured devices, memory-adjacent compute, and security checks at the library level. The common thread is moving useful work closer to sensors, memories, and specialized fabrics while keeping an eye on retention, thermal paths, and implementation risk.
dek.zh: 本周研究阅读队列突出已测器件、靠近存储的计算，以及标准单元库层面的安全检查。共同主线是在传感器、存储和专用计算织构附近完成更多有用工作，同时关注保持特性、热路径和实现风险。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Triple-Hysteresis Antiferroelectric Thin Films for Giant Negative Electrocaloric Effect
title.zh: 用于巨大负电热效应的三重滞回反铁电薄膜

papers.authors: P. Su, J. Chen, J. Li, et al.

summary.en: Su et al. stabilize a ferrielectric phase inside low-temperature PbZrO3 thin films, creating a triple-hysteresis loop rather than the usual ferroelectric or antiferroelectric response. The reported electrocaloric temperature change reaches -23.76 K by Maxwell-relation extraction, about a 600% enhancement versus the double-hysteresis baseline in the abstract. The result is interesting for solid-state cooling and multistate memory, but the cooling number is still an inferred device metric rather than a packaged thermal system.
summary.zh: Su等人在低温制备的PbZrO3薄膜中稳定出铁电相，在常见铁电或反铁电响应之外形成三重滞回回线。摘要给出的基于Maxwell关系提取的电热温变达到-23.76 K，较双重滞回基线提升约600%。该结果对固态制冷和多态存储有吸引力，但这个制冷指标仍是器件层面推导值，而不是封装热系统实测。

title.en: Al2O3 Barrier Engineering Improves HfO2-Based Si-Channel FeFET Retention
title.zh: Al2O3势垒工程提升HfO2基硅沟道FeFET保持特性

papers.authors: Z. Chen, T. Hu, X. Jia, et al.

summary.en: Chen et al. insert Al2O3 layers as both tunneling dielectric and gate interlayer in an HfZrO2 FeFET stack. With a 2 nm tunneling layer and 3 nm gate interlayer, the devices show a 9 V memory window and projected 0.44% memory-window loss over 10 years at -13 V to +14 V operation. The retention result is strong for FeFET scaling discussions, but the operating voltage and stack complexity remain important manufacturability questions.
summary.zh: Chen等人在HfZrO2 FeFET栈中引入Al2O3，同时作为隧穿介质层和栅介质插层。在2 nm隧穿层与3 nm栅插层条件下，器件显示9 V存储窗口，并在-13 V至+14 V工作下预测10年存储窗口损失仅0.44%。这一保持特性对FeFET缩放很有参考价值，但工作电压和堆栈复杂度仍是制造可行性的关键问题。

title.en: GaN-on-Diamond HEMTs Reach 25 W/mm at X-Band
title.zh: 金刚石衬底GaN HEMT在X波段达到25 W/mm

papers.authors: X. Zhou, G. Zhou, Y. Lv, et al.

summary.en: Zhou et al. fabricate AlGaN/GaN HEMTs on polycrystalline diamond using room-temperature wafer bonding and a roughly 17 nm bonding interface. Load-pull measurements on 4 x 100 micron devices report 25.28 W/mm at 10 GHz with 33.43% power-added efficiency, while channel temperature falls by about 150 C versus GaN-on-SiC at 31.5 W/mm DC power density. The paper attacks the RF power thermal wall directly; the next question is whether the bonding interface can scale with yield and cost.
summary.zh: Zhou等人通过室温晶圆键合和约17 nm键合界面，在多晶金刚石衬底上制备AlGaN/GaN HEMT。4 x 100微米器件的负载牵引测试在10 GHz下达到25.28 W/mm，功率附加效率为33.43%，并且在31.5 W/mm直流功率密度下相比GaN-on-SiC沟道温度降低约150 C。论文直接针对RF功率器件的热墙；下一步问题是该键合界面能否以可接受良率和成本放大。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Probabilistic Memory for Edge-AI Sampling at Native Memory Bandwidth
title.zh: 面向边缘AI的原生带宽概率存储

papers.authors: L. Pei, J. Zheng, X. Zhao, et al.

summary.en: Pei et al. propose p-MEM, a memory primitive that stores distribution parameters and samples directly at memory bandwidth instead of generating Gaussian random numbers as a separate compute step. The layout-validated simulator reports more than 1000 GSa/s/mm2 GRNG throughput, plus CPU/GPU reductions of up to 2.19x/4.37x in instruction count, 562x/3.45x in sampling latency, and 295.5x/3.53x in energy for Bayesian neural-network workloads. This is a hardware-relevant answer to probabilistic AI overhead, but it remains a simulated architecture rather than measured silicon.
summary.zh: Pei等人提出p-MEM，一种存储分布参数并直接以存储带宽采样的存储原语，而不是把高斯随机数生成作为独立计算步骤。经过版图验证的模拟器显示，GRNG吞吐超过1000 GSa/s/mm2，并在贝叶斯神经网络负载中让CPU/GPU指令数最多降低2.19x/4.37x，采样延迟降低562x/3.45x，能耗降低295.5x/3.53x。这是对概率AI开销的硬件化回应，但目前仍是模拟架构而非实测硅片。

title.en: A 28-nm System-in-One-Macro eDRAM Compute-in-Memory Chip
title.zh: 28 nm系统级单宏eDRAM存内计算芯片

papers.authors: Z. Qian, Z. Cong, S. Yan, et al.

summary.en: Qian et al. present a 28 nm compute-in-memory chip that pulls system-level components, except control logic, into a single macro. The design uses leakage-eliminated 2T1C and capacitor-over-logic 1T1C eDRAM to reduce the SRAM access, long interconnect, and accumulation overheads that often erase macro-level CIM gains. The paper is valuable because it treats CIM as a system layout problem, not only as a bitcell energy-efficiency claim.
summary.zh: Qian等人展示了一颗28 nm存内计算芯片，把除控制逻辑外的系统级组件整合进单个宏单元。该设计采用消除漏电的2T1C和电容置于逻辑之上的1T1C eDRAM，以减少SRAM访问、长互连和累加单元开销，这些开销常常抵消宏单元层面的CIM收益。论文的价值在于把CIM视为系统版图问题，而不只是位单元能效声明。

title.en: A Booth-Based Digital SRAM CIM Macro With 16.8 TOPS/W at 8b/8b
title.zh: 8b/8b下达到16.8 TOPS/W的Booth数字SRAM CIM宏

papers.authors: Y. Jiang, X. Wang, H. You, et al.
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) Systems

summary.en: Jiang et al. build a Booth-based all-digital SRAM CIM macro for flexible multiply-accumulate operations across bit widths. The 55 nm CMOS measurement reports 16.8 TOPS/W for 8b/8b MACs, using pre-encoding, two-transistor bit retention and shifting, and multiphase accumulation to reduce overhead. It is a practical digital-CIM entry because the result keeps standard CMOS and integer precision in view, though array-scale integration details still determine system usefulness.
summary.zh: Jiang等人构建了一个基于Booth编码的全数字SRAM CIM宏，用于支持不同位宽的乘加运算。55 nm CMOS实测在8b/8b MAC下达到16.8 TOPS/W，并通过预编码、两晶体管位保持与移位、多相累加来降低开销。这是一个更偏实用的数字CIM结果，因为它保留了标准CMOS和整数精度视角，但系统价值仍取决于阵列级集成细节。

title.en: BRAM-Free Approximate Softmax for FPGA Vision Transformer Inference
title.zh: 面向FPGA视觉Transformer推理的无BRAM近似Softmax

papers.authors: M. Usman, S. Khan, D. Merhof

summary.en: Usman et al. replace the costly softmax exponential in FPGA Vision Transformer inference with a 16-segment piecewise-linear natural-exponential approximation implemented in distributed LUT fabric. On a Xilinx Zynq-7020 attention-row core, the design uses 1444 LUTs, 77 DSPs, and no BRAM, avoiding table-heavy or CORDIC-style implementations. The hardware angle is clear for small FPGAs, but the reported result is still core-level and depends on model-level accuracy under approximation.
summary.zh: Usman等人用16段分段线性自然指数近似替代FPGA视觉Transformer推理中昂贵的softmax指数计算，并完全用分布式LUT织构实现。在Xilinx Zynq-7020的attention-row核心上，该设计使用1444个LUT、77个DSP且不占用BRAM，避免了查表密集或CORDIC式实现。其硬件价值对小型FPGA很明确，但结果仍处于核心级，最终取决于近似下的模型级精度。

title.en: Circuits & Architectures
title.zh: 电路与架构

title.en: A 2T-Pixel CMOS Imager for In-Pixel Multi-Bit Feature Extraction
title.zh: 用于像素内多比特特征提取的2T像素CMOS图像传感器

papers.authors: A. Abubakar, B. Wang, A. Bermak
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems Part 1: Regular Papers

summary.en: Abubakar et al. demonstrate a computational CMOS image sensor that performs signed analog-domain multi-bit convolution directly inside the pixel array. The 0.18-micron prototype keeps a 43% fill factor, supports up to eight programmable convolution kernels per frame, and reports 1.5-2.0 TOPS/W normalized to 1-bit at 14-112 fps and 61.8-82.4 microwatts total chip power. This is useful edge-vision silicon because it removes intermediate SRAM and DAC storage, though the normalized precision metric should be read carefully.
summary.zh: Abubakar等人展示了一种计算型CMOS图像传感器，可在像素阵列内直接执行带符号模拟域多比特卷积。0.18微米原型保持43%填充因子，每帧支持最多8个可编程卷积核，并在14-112 fps、整芯片61.8-82.4微瓦功耗下给出按1-bit归一化的1.5-2.0 TOPS/W。该硅片对边缘视觉有价值，因为它去除了中间SRAM和DAC存储，但归一化精度指标需要谨慎解读。

title.en: EDA & Hardware Security
title.zh: EDA与硬件安全

title.en: LIB-TRAP Tests Hardware-Trojan Risk in Standard Cell Libraries
title.zh: LIB-TRAP评估标准单元库中的硬件木马风险

papers.authors: H. K. Dharavath, M. M. A. Chowdhury, R. Yasaei, et al.

summary.en: Dharavath et al. move the hardware-Trojan threat model into the standard cell library itself, treating the library as untrusted rather than assuming malicious insertion only around placed cells. Using EDA flows with Saed32nm and Sky130nm libraries, they show how malicious cells can mask arbitrary Trojans from designers until a foundry-side replacement activates them. The result is important for fabless security reviews because it pushes trust boundaries down to library provenance and signoff, though the strongest attacks assume a coordinated adversarial supply chain.
summary.zh: Dharavath等人把硬件木马威胁模型推进到标准单元库本身，将库视为不可信，而不是只假设木马被插入到已布局单元周围。他们使用Saed32nm和Sky130nm库的EDA流程，展示恶意单元如何在设计者面前隐藏任意木马，直到晶圆厂侧替换激活。该结果对无晶圆厂安全审查很重要，因为它把信任边界下推到库来源和签核流程；但最强攻击仍假设存在协同的恶意供应链。
